raw.title: Alaska Purchase
raw.description: 1867 sale by Russia to the United States
raw.extract: The Alaska Purchase in 1867 resulted in the transfer of Russian America to the United States for $7.2 million. On April 9 of that year, the United States Senate ratified a bilateral treaty that had been signed on March 30, and American sovereignty became legally effective across the territory on October 18.
